Bio

Martin Roméo is a bilingual Francophone filmmaker from Winnipeg, Manitoba: a director, editor and cinematographer working across television, documentary and music.

His experience spans the whole pipeline: camera, sound department and audio mixing, visual effects and motion graphics, production, music composition and editing. He can shoot a scene, cut it, mix it and score it, and he understands what each department needs from the others.

His credits include Malgré Moi (Radio-Canada), C’est moi qui décide! (Unis TV) and Métis Foodies (APTN). His music work includes projects for William Prince, Faouzia and John Legend.

He is a member of the Directors Guild of Canada and a graduate of the ASC Masterclass.
